HEY, HOBOKEN. now wears the card’s own lockup: Genova Medium, uppercase, stacked, in the same tones as WHAT’S YOUR COFFEE ARCHETYPE? So the page a crawler lands on speaks the exact voice of the card they just scanned.
Order restored: greeting, the "today the whole city is tasting" line, the photograph, then the quiz. The picture bridges the welcome and the ask.
"Whose palate are we profiling today?" is borrowed from the quiz entry page, in the deep pink at Genova Regular, sitting directly above the name field the way it does on the site. The question mark is Gotham, per the brand rule.
Color balance: pink works as the accent, not the ground. It appears only on the word palate, on FOR CRAWLERS ONLY, on the Good. highlight, and in HEY, up top. The button and the gives hold terracotta. On the built page the button can additionally stay pinned to the bottom edge on phones while scrolling.
Type: Genova Medium for the lockup and the palate line, Thin for body, Regular for small tracked lines, Black for the button; Gotham ampersands and question mark. All colors palette-only; no pure white.
For Dana: this is the /crawl destination behind the printed QR. Scans, quiz starts, and signups from this page carry the crawl tag, which is also how the free shipping attaches and the five winners get drawn.
